title: Patient Payment Plans Schedule of First-Phase Installments by Financial Class
content:
A signed Patient Payment Plans agreement carries a first-phase installment set by the financial class of the patient's Patient Financial Account.

| Financial class of the Patient Financial Account | First-phase installment |
|---|---|
| Self-Pay Account | Level installment multiplied by 0.80, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | Level installment multiplied by 0.90, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | Level installment multiplied by 0.90, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | The level installment itself |
| Medicare Part B Account | The level installment itself |
| Medicare Advantage Account | The level installment itself |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | The level installment itself |

**Rule of the schedule.** The first-phase installment follows the financial class of the account: on the Self-Pay Account it is the level installment multiplied by 0.80 and rounded down to the whole dollar; on the High-Deductible Health Plan Account and the Commercial PPO/POS Account it is the level installment multiplied by 0.90 and rounded down to the whole dollar; on every other class it is the level installment itself. The *level installment* is the plan balance at signing less the down payment at signing, divided by the tier's term, rounded half up to the cent.

**The phase.** The installments of the first phase carry the first-phase amount for the first twelve months, and the later installments absorb the difference, the final installment absorbing any remainder. The installment written into the signed agreement is worked from the first-phase installment and is never below the tier's minimum installment.

**Figures (hypothetical level installment of 131.25).**

| Class | Computation | First-phase installment |
|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Account | 131.25 multiplied by 0.80 is 105.00 | 105.00 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 131.25 multiplied by 0.90 is 118.125; rounded down | 118.00 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | As above | 118.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | Level installment | 131.25 |
